get.description: Reports whether the service is up and which keys are set (never their values).

Everything the interface needs before a run: limits, industries, examples, stages and
limits. Never a key.

post.description: Structure a founder's idea into problem, solution, customers, industry and features.
Fetch live market and competitor information for an extracted idea.

Run the whole pipeline: structure the idea, research it and, with include_analysis,
analyse its market and competitors. The UI always asks for the analysis, and that run is
time-limited so it answers before the UI stops waiting (orchestrator.TIME_LIMIT_SHARE).

parameters.name: include_analysis

schema.description: Also run the Market Opportunity and Competitor Analysis stages (Milestone 2). Without it, only extraction and web search run, as in Milestone 1.
schema.title: Include Analysis

parameters.description: Also run the Market Opportunity and Competitor Analysis stages (Milestone 2). Without it, only extraction and web search run, as in Milestone 1.

post.description:
Start a run and answer immediately. With `idea_override`, the idea the founder reviewed is
used and the extraction stage is not run again. With `include_strategy` (Milestone 3) the three
strategy stages follow, using `constraints`. A third concurrent run is refused with 409.

get.description: A run's state, its stages and, once a stage has finished, the result so far.

delete.description: Delete a saved validation. A run that is still going must be cancelled first.

post.description:
Ask a run to stop. Cancelling is cooperative: the pipeline stops before its next stage or
outside call, so a call already in flight finishes first and the state becomes `cancelled`
only once the work has actually stopped.

get.description:
The Markdown report of a finished run, as a download. It is the full report even when both
analyses are missing, so a partial or failed run still explains itself.

Basis.title: Basis
Basis.description: How a claim is grounded. Subclasses str so it serialises as the bare string.

Comparison.title: Comparison
Comparison.description: The feature matrix. `feature_coverage` is counted from the rows in code.

CompetitorAnalysisResult.title: CompetitorAnalysisResult
CompetitorAnalysisResult.description: Section 8.1: the checked competitor analysis that the agent writes to the context.

CompetitorCandidate.title: CompetitorCandidate
CompetitorCandidate.description: Phase A: a competitor or alternative named in the evidence, or named by the founder.

ConstraintLimits.title: ConstraintLimits
ConstraintLimits.description: The limits StrategyConstraints enforces and the choices it accepts (Section 12.3).

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: The one error shape every route returns (app.py).

EvidenceStrength.title: EvidenceStrength
EvidenceStrength.description: How well the findings are backed by sources (Section 8.5). Not a prediction of success.

ExtractedIdeaLimits.title: ExtractedIdeaLimits
ExtractedIdeaLimits.description: What the review step may edit, with the limits ExtractedIdea enforces.

MarketFigure.title: MarketFigure
MarketFigure.description:
A Task 1 market-size figure. `scope` says which market it measures: `idea_market` for
this idea's own product, customers and region, `broader_market` for a wider or different
market such as a whole industry. Only Task 1 uses it; QuantEstimate stays unchanged.

MarketGap.title: MarketGap
MarketGap.description: A gap hypothesis: confidence is never above medium and the caveat is always set.

MarketOpportunityResult.title: MarketOpportunityResult
MarketOpportunityResult.description: Section 7.1: the checked market analysis that the agent writes to the shared context.

MarketSize.title: MarketSize
MarketSize.description: TAM, SAM and SOM for this idea's own market only (figures with scope `idea_market`).

Notice.title: Notice
Notice.description:
A quality note in plain words. `message` never holds a field path or an evidence id;
`detail` keeps the technical text it came from, for developers.

ProviderStatus.title: ProviderStatus
ProviderStatus.description: Whether a provider is configured. Configured is not the same as tested: no call is made.

RunDetail.title: RunDetail
RunDetail.description:
A run's state. `result` is the final result once the run has ended; while it runs, it holds
what the finished stages produced so far (a partial snapshot), or null before any stage ends.

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description:
Start a run. `idea_override` is the extracted idea after the founder's review; with it the
extraction stage is not run again.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description:
One row of the history list. `status` is the result's status when there is a result.
`has_strategy` (Milestone 3) says whether the run asked for the strategy stages or was given them
later; it is always sent, and optional in the schema only so existing clients stay valid.

StrategyInfo.title: StrategyInfo

StrategyRequest.title: StrategyRequest
StrategyRequest.description: Generate strategy for a saved run (Section 12.2). `missing` runs only the absent stages.

SummaryLine.title: SummaryLine
SummaryLine.description:
One executive-summary line. `source_ids` refer to the sources of `analysis` (the market
and competitor analyses number their evidence separately). `basis` is None for a statement
that code counted or composed, such as the number of competitors found.

VerifyItem.title: VerifyItem
VerifyItem.description: One "what to verify next" item, built from an unavailable, estimated or low-confidence part.
